evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Content identification and fingerprinting are independently implementable/testable features for music discovery.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Both actions are part of a single feature: profile-based music discovery.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Both actions are part of a single feature: similarity-based music discovery.

evaluations.rationale: Searching for music and ringback tones are independently implementable/testable features.

evaluations.rationale: Finding related artists, new genres, and other paths are independently implementable/testable features.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: info retrieval for perceptual similarity.
